aliases: cpsm exam 3 leadership in supply management
exam_name: CPSM Exam 3 — Leadership in Supply Management
exam_price_notes: ISM member price $595. Non-member price $765. Exams 1 and 2 must be passed before taking Exam 3.
exam_rules: Closed-book. Open-book NOT permitted. No notes or reference materials. All three CPSM exams must be passed within a 3-year window to earn the CPSM designation.
id_requirements: One government-issued photo ID with full name and signature. Name must match ISM registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-15: the CPSM page lists the three CPSM exams, Exam 3 titled 'Leadership and Transformation in Supply Management', with learning systems and registration; no retirement wording.

official_study_resources.notes: Official ISM study guides and learning system available for purchase on the ISM website
official_study_resources.title: ISM CPSM Study Materials

official_study_resources.notes: Official practice exams available through the ISM Learning System
official_study_resources.title: ISM CPSM Practice Exams

prerequisites.description: Passing scores on CPSM Exam 1 and Exam 2
Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
3 years of supply management experience in a professional-level position

renewal_options: Earn 60 continuing education hours (CEHs) every 3 years and pay the recertification fee. CEHs can be earned through ISM-approved courses, conferences, seminars, teaching, and publications.

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Computer-based testing at Prometric test centers worldwide. Online proctoring available for select windows.
